cases.sentence: Женщина, вся в черном с головы до пят, стояла у ___.
cases.explain: The preposition «у» meaning 'by, next to' always governs the genitive, so окно becomes окна.
This is the direct object of «прижимала», which takes the accusative; платочек is inanimate, so its accusative looks like the nominative.
Verbs of shaking or swinging a body part, like «болтать», take the instrumental: болтать ногами.
The recipient of «оставить» — the person something is left to — stands in the dative: оставить людям.

cases.sentence: Я его не видел с прошлого ___.
cases.explain: «С» in the sense of 'since, starting from' a point in time requires the genitive: с прошлого августа.

cases.sentence: Повернула ко мне сиплое, надтреснутое лицо, все в ___.
cases.explain: «В» describing a state or what something is covered with — answering «где?», not «куда?» — takes the prepositional: в слезах.

cases.sentence: Вошел ___, весь в желтом, мой камердинер по имени Петр.
cases.explain: This word is the subject of «вошел», so it stands in the nominative even though it follows the verb.

reading.question: What did Venichka find the woman in black doing when he crept up behind her?
reading.explain: He tiptoes up so as not to frighten off the charm of the scene, and discovers that she is weeping.

reading.question: According to Venichka's reflection, why does a person seek solitude?
reading.explain: He argues that a person withdraws to cry, not because he is lonely to begin with, but because he does not want anyone sharing his tears.

reading.question: What does the princess tell Venichka to stop doing?
reading.explain: She snaps at him to stop swinging his legs and to sit quietly instead.

reading.question: Venichka claims he can see a mouth organ on the princess from behind — what does she say it really is?
reading.explain: She corrects him without turning round: it is not a mouth organ but the bridge of her nose.

reading.ru: Жаль, что я забыл, о чем эта загадка, но помню, что-то очень важное…
reading.question: What has Venichka forgotten as he stands there?
options: What the riddle he set out to solve was about
Which station the train has just left
The name of his own valet
How much money he has left
reading.correct: What the riddle he set out to solve was about
reading.explain: He remembers only that he walked through all the carriages to solve some riddle, and that it was something very important.

reading.ru: Он такой же твой, как и мой!
reading.question: How does the princess answer when Venichka asks where her valet Pyotr is?
options: She snaps that the valet is as much his as hers
She says the valet died last August
She says the valet is in the next carriage
She says she has never had a valet
reading.correct: She snaps that the valet is as much his as hers
reading.explain: She retorts that Pyotr belongs to Venichka just as much as to her, then storms off towards the doors.

reading.question: What name does the princess use when she shouts that she hates him?
reading.explain: At the doors she turns her tear-covered face to him and shouts that she hates him, calling him Andrei Mikhailovich.

reading.ru: Вошел слуга, весь в желтом, мой камердинер по имени Петр.
reading.question: How is the valet Pyotr dressed, and why?
options: All in yellow, because Venichka once drunkenly advised him to dress that way
All in black, in mourning for the princess
In a railway uniform, because he works on the train
In rags, because he has no money
reading.correct: All in yellow, because Venichka once drunkenly advised him to dress that way
reading.explain: Venichka says he once told him while drunk to go about in yellow until his death, and the fool has obeyed ever since.

reading.question: What does Pyotr answer when asked whether Venichka has been asleep?
options: That he slept in the other carriage but not in this one
That he has been awake the whole journey
That he slept in this carriage but not in the other one
That he was asleep in both carriages
reading.correct: That he slept in the other carriage but not in this one
reading.explain: Pyotr's answers are that yes, he slept in that carriage, and no, not in this one.

reading.ru: А вот какая: выпить у меня чего-нибудь осталось?..
reading.question: What turns out to be the enormous thought Venichka cannot resolve?
options: Whether he has anything left to drink
Whether he was asleep or awake
reading.correct: Whether he has anything left to drink
reading.explain: After building the question up as a thought too great to solve, he reveals it is simply whether he has any drink left.

highlight.question: Which sentence explains what a person actually wants when he cries?
sentences: Вот!
Человек уединяется, чтобы поплакать.
Но изначально он не одинок.
Когда человек плачет, он просто не хочет, чтобы кто-нибудь был сопричастен его слезам.
И правильно делает, ибо есть ли что-нибудь на свете выше безутешности?..
О, сказать бы сейчас такое, такое сказать бы, – чтобы брызнули слезы из глаз всех матерей, чтобы в траур облеклись дворцы и хижины, кишлаки и аулы!..
highlight.explain: The fourth sentence gives the motive — he does not want anyone else sharing in his tears.

highlight.question: Which sentence says that Venichka could not remember why he had set off through the carriages?
sentences: «Ну что ж, кустик, так кустик».
Я сразу как-то обмяк, сел на лавку и разомлел.
Никак, хоть умри, никак я не мог припомнить, для чего я пошел по вагонам и встретил вот эту женщину…
О чем же все-таки это «важное»?
highlight.explain: The third sentence states the failure of memory; the last only asks what the important thing was.

highlight.question: Which sentence complains that the princess went away without answering the main question?
sentences: «Вот это да-а-а, – протянул я восторженно, как давеча декабрист. – Ловко она меня отбрила!»
И ведь так и ушла, не ответив на самое главное!..
Царица Небесная, что же это главное?
Именем щедрот твоих – дай припомнить!..
Камердинер!
highlight.explain: The second sentence is the complaint that she left the main question unanswered.

highlight.question: Which sentence admits that Venichka loves something he does not really understand?
sentences: – Чудно мне это, Петр…
Зажги-ка канделябры.
Я люблю, когда горят канделябры, хоть и не знаю толком, что это такое…
А то, знаешь, опять мне делается тревожно…
Значит, Петр, если тебе верить: я в том вагоне спал, а в этом проснулся.
Так?
highlight.explain: He says he loves burning candelabra while confessing he does not properly know what they are.
